{{Quote|Garel Shuttle 3765 from Coruscant has arrived in Bay 22.|Announcer to Garel City Spaceport|<ref name="Blood Sisters">{{Rebels|Blood Sisters}}</ref>}}
'''Garel Shuttle 3765''' was a [[GX1 short hauler]] on the [[planet]] [[Garel]]. In [[4 BBY]], the [[shuttle]] landed in [[Bay 22]] of the [[Garel City Spaceport]]. [[Spectres]] [[Sabine Wren]], [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] heard an announcer mention to spaceport passengers that the [[shuttle]] had arrived from [[Coruscant]] as they entered a [[Hangar|docking bay]] in search of the [[courier]] [[EG-86]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Garel Shuttle 3765 first appeared in "[[Blood Sisters]]," the eighth episode of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|Season Two]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />
